title: Pending Sources
description: Owner-approved URL list for a single research run. The fetcher reads this file and only fetches URLs that appear here. Edit by hand; no auto-population. An empty sources array is valid and produces zero network activity.

run_id.description: The immutable_run_id of the research run this pending-sources file belongs to. Must match the run directory name.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this file was created or last rewritten by the owner.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last manual edit. Optional.

approved_by.description: Owner handle that approved the URL list as a whole. Each source also records its own approver.

notes.description: Free-form owner notes about the URL list.

sources.description: Approved URLs to fetch. Empty array is valid and means 'no fetches in this phase'.

source_id.description: Run-local unique identifier. Format suggestion: source-NNN.

url.description: URL to fetch. Must be http or https (validated separately at fetch time).

title_hint.description: Owner's hint for the source title; recorded but not authoritative.

source_type.description: Source type for downstream policy checks.

reason.description: Why the owner approved this URL for this run.

approved_by.description: Owner handle that approved this specific URL.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval for this URL.
